nodes.label: VERCEL_SCOPE Configured Gate
nodes.rationale: Gated on vars.VERCEL_SCOPE being set so that forking the template gives users working CI and tests for free, while the audit job simply stays idle (not failing) until they configure their own Vercel account credentials.

nodes.label: vercel login Local Auth Alternative
nodes.rationale: VERCEL_TOKEN can be skipped for local interactive use in favor of `vercel login` because the token is only strictly required for non-interactive CI runs.

nodes.label: Motivation for Building Guardian
nodes.rationale: Built after a client's production deployment sat broken for two weeks unnoticed because `vercel ls` only confirms a deployment exists — it doesn't verify the production alias serves 200s, that Web Analytics is configured, or that an unexpected deploy hook was added.

nodes.label: redactUrlSecrets Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Every URL written into a report is passed through redactUrlSecrets first because reports may contain webhook URLs, log-drain destinations, or query strings carrying token/secret/key/auth/password/sig/credential-like params; redacting them (plus stripping userinfo and provider webhook trailing secret segments) ensures the audit tool never leaks a secret value — the one behavior the author says they'd never want to regress silently.
